1.consolidated_definition: mod. Hombre o mujer modelo de alta costura, muy cotizado. Anglicismo crudo, usual. DRAE 2001: voz inglesa. Cabe destacar que entre las misses que han tomado este taller se encuentran Denise Quiñones y Carla Tricoli; aparte de las top models puertorriqueñas Marcella Cortés, Cynthia Olavarría y Mari Tere Benes (CREA PR, Vea Online, 11-05-03)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Supermodel. Informal term for a highly sought-after fashion model, often used in Puerto Rican culture. 

Note: The reference to "CREA PR" and "Vea Online" is likely a citation from a specific article or source, which would be included in the original text but not translated here.

Also, note that "top models puertorriqueñas" translates to "Puerto Rican top models".
